name: Wells Fargo Arena
description: The premier large-scale concert and event venue in Des Moines, hosting major touring acts, Iowa Wild hockey, and Iowa Wolves basketball.

name: Hoyt Sherman Place
description: A beautiful historic theater built in 1877, hosting intimate concerts, comedy, and performing arts in a stunning gilded-age setting.

name: Woolys
description: Des Moines' most popular mid-size indie music venue in the East Village, known for its intimate atmosphere and eclectic bookings.
address: 504 E Locust St, Des Moines, IA 50309

name: xBk
description: A versatile community-centered venue combining live music, art exhibitions, and coworking space in the Historic East Village.

name: Leftys Live Music
description: A laid-back live music venue offering local and touring bands across rock, blues, country, and more in a classic bar setting.

name: Val Air Ballroom
description: A historic 1930s ballroom in West Des Moines hosting concerts, comedy shows, and special events with retro charm.
address: 301 Ashworth Rd, West Des Moines, IA 50265

name: Des Moines Civic Center
description: The anchor performing arts venue downtown, presenting Broadway tours, concerts, ballet, and the Des Moines Symphony.

name: Simon Estes Amphitheater
description: A beautiful outdoor amphitheater along the Des Moines River, hosting summer concerts, festivals, and community events.
address: 75 E Locust St, Des Moines, IA 50309

name: Vibrant Music Hall
description: A newer mid-size concert hall in Waukee offering a modern concert experience for touring and regional acts.
